actsreferredto.p: Loan Guarantee Schemes Agreements (Strategic Banking Corporation of Ireland) Act 2021 (No. 9)

frontmatter.p: An Act to make provision in relation to the giving of guarantees by the Minister for Enterprise, Trade and Employment under the Credit Guarantee Act 2012 in accordance with a credit guarantee scheme made under that Act by that Minister of the Government in response to the economic difficulties resulting from the aggression against Ukraine by Russia; to place a monetary limit on the potential liability of that Minister of the Government in respect of such a credit guarantee scheme; to extend the classes of enterprise to which such a credit guarantee scheme may apply; and, for those purposes, to amend the Credit Guarantee Act 2012 and the Credit Guarantee (Amendment) Act 2016; to amend the Loan Guarantee Schemes Agreements (Strategic Banking Corporation of Ireland) Act 2021; and to provide for related matters.

p.b: Be it enacted by the Oireachtas as follows:

sect.p: 1. In this Act, Act of 2012 means the Credit Guarantee Act 2012.
